Note for reviewers: The implementation intentionally deviates from the originally described trusted endorser signature design. Instead of issuing and verifying an endorsement signature, this milestone delivers the later planned ZK-proof path: the service receives an EUDI credential presentation, extracts the disclosed claim, generates a privacy-preserving proof, and verifies that proof with a Cardano smart contract. Public testnet evidence is provided on Cardano preview; this differs from the original preprod wording.
Thank you and looking forward to your reviews!

A. zk-SNARK circuit
Output: 
The endorser was extended with a Groth16 zk-SNARK circuit for SD-JWT presentations. The circuit verifies the credential signature and selective-disclosure structure, extracts the requested claim, and binds the proof to a user-supplied Cardano Shelley address. Proof generation, local proof verification, witness generation, and conversion of the public inputs for Cardano are integrated into the Rust service. The implementation is published under the Apache-2.0 license in release `v0.3.0`.
Acceptance criteria: 
The endorser generates independently verifiable zk-SNARK proofs for SD-JWT credentials without relying on an endorser signature. Five proof-verification transactions are documented on Cardano Preprod. The proof exposes only the circuit's defined public inputs; the credential presentation and remaining credential attributes are not published on-chain.
Evidence:
- [Milestone 3 implementation (`v0.3.0`)](https://github.com/perun-network/eudi2web3/tree/v0.3.0)
- [SD-JWT verification and proof-generation integration](https://github.com/perun-network/eudi2web3/blob/v0.3.0/src/lib.rs)
- [zk-SNARK circuit, including signature verification, selective disclosure, claim extraction, and address binding](https://github.com/perun-network/eudi2web3/blob/v0.3.0/circuits/core.circom)
- [Groth16 prover integration](https://github.com/perun-network/eudi2web3/blob/v0.3.0/src/prover/snarkjs.rs)
- [Apache-2.0 license](https://github.com/perun-network/eudi2web3/blob/v0.3.0/LICENSE)

B. Smart Contract Verifier
Output: 
An Aiken/Plutus V3 validator verifies the BLS12-381 Groth16 proof against the circuit verification key and the public claim/address inputs before permitting the protected UTXO to be spent. The `small (bls12-381, 1 contribution)` verifier was deployed and tested on Cardano Preprod.
